title: Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation
title_zh: 通过残差空间适配实现扩散模型的持续概念个性化

paragraphs.en: 本文提出基于残差空间适配的扩散模型持续概念个性化方法，在近零遗忘下实现最高概念保真度，并可减少72%可训练参数。 Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Beyond these empirical gains, the learned residual-space dynamics reveal where adaptation capacity is concentrated within the diffusion model. Restricting adaptation to the identified layers by our method preserves nearly the same performance while reducing the number of trainable parameters by up to 72\%, demonstrating that residual-space dynamics can identify the layers that contribute most to continual concept personalization and directly guide more parameter-efficient adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出基于残差空间适配的扩散模型持续概念个性化方法，在近零遗忘下实现最高概念保真度，并可减少72%可训练参数。文生图个性化旨在使预训练扩散模型具备仅从少量参考图像中学习用户特定概念的能力。 然而，现有方法通常独立训练每个概念，或假设所有概念同时可用。 在实际应用中，概念往往按顺序到来，这要求模型在持续学习新的主体、物体或风格的同时，尽量减少对已获得概念的干扰。 我们通过将残差空间适配扩展到预训练扩散模型的随机适配过程，来解决这一持续概念个性化设定。 我们的工作在相互竞争的持续个性化方法中实现了最高的概念保真度，同时保持近零遗忘。 除了这些经验性收益外，学习到的残差空间动态还揭示了适配容量在扩散模型中的集中位置。 将适配限制在我们方法识别出的层上，几乎能保持相同的性能，同时最多可将可训练参数减少72%，这表明残差空间动态能够识别对持续概念个性化贡献最大的层，并直接指导更节省参数的适配。
